jobs.title: Digital Producer
jobs.reason: Requires a minimum of 5 years creating digital e-learning content plus 3 years managing educational projects — well beyond entry-level and a hard experience disqualifier. It also demands e-learning production expertise the candidate lacks, and the role sits outside all interest zones.

jobs.title: Aerospace Auditor
jobs.reason: This is a specialist aerospace quality-management auditor role requiring deep sector expertise in AS9100/ISO 9001 assessment and the ability to lead assessment teams — experience the candidate plainly lacks and well beyond entry level. It sits entirely outside all three interest zones and offers no paper fit.

jobs.title: Customer Service Team Leader
jobs.reason: A "Team Leader" role that essentially requires people-management experience within a client-service environment — clearly not entry-level and beyond the candidate's student-assistant background. It is also a customer-service administration function with no connection to any of the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Food Safety Auditor (USA)
jobs.reason: This is an on-demand food safety/health-and-safety auditing contractor role requiring practical audit and inspection expertise entirely outside the candidate's research and policy profile, so paper fit is very weak. It sits in none of the candidate's interest zones and offers no meaningful skills transfer, making it barely worth surfacing.
jobs.location: Houston / various US states (North/South Carolina, Florida, Nevada, Hawaii, Northern California)

jobs.title: Performance & Capability Consultant
jobs.reason: Not entry-level — this is a senior consulting role (£80k–90k band) requiring a proven track record of delivering organisational development outcomes, coaching senior executives, and leading change in a Centre of Excellence, none of which the candidate can meet. It is also an HR/organisational-development function well outside the candidate's research and policy interests.

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established "experts" to join an advisory committee — not an entry-level paid role, and it explicitly seeks seasoned specialists (effectively senior-level). It also reads as an advisory/voluntary appointment rather than a genuine paid vacancy, so it fails the entry-level and paid-role gates despite the strong human-rights subject match.

jobs.title: Senior Finance Officer-Sahel
jobs.reason: Location fails the London-only filter — the role is based in Niamey, Niger with no London or remote-UK option. It is also a senior finance-specialist role outside the candidate's profile.

jobs.title: Academic Head of Division – Clinical Psychology (AC.06.3)
jobs.reason: Requires a Clinical Psychology qualification registerable with the HPCSA plus 5+ years as a clinical psychologist and 5+ years at mid-management level — all essentials the candidate plainly lacks. It is also a senior academic headship, not entry-level, and falls outside the candidate's fields.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an advisory committee, not a genuine paid entry-level role — it seeks established specialists (and the profile centres on activist experience from specific regions), which is a level and role-type mismatch; it also reads as an unpaid/advisory posting rather than a salaried vacancy. The human-rights/securitisation subject is genuinely interesting, but neither the level nor the paid-role criterion is met.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator, Sudan Witness - Contractor
jobs.reason: This is a project-coordination / grant-management and administrative role rather than a research post; the candidate's project-administration and funding-allocation experience at the German Rectors' Conference is a reasonable partial fit, though the role leans heavily on grant-management and logistics coordination the candidate has only touched. CIR is a core zone (c) OSINT / human-rights investigations organisation, which lifts interest, but the fit is administrative rather than analytical and Arabic / Sudan experience (desirable, not essential) would help — nothing here disqualifies.

jobs.title: Residence Cluster Manager (AD07)
jobs.reason: This is a "Manager" role requiring at least 5 years of managerial experience including staff management and budgeting — well beyond the candidate's entry-level profile and a clear disqualifier. It is also an operational student-housing role with no research or policy relevance to the candidate's interests.

jobs.title: Team Leader - CASA 3
jobs.reason: A "Team Leader" title indicates a senior role requiring substantial leadership and post-qualification experience the candidate does not have — not entry-level. The level mismatch is a hard disqualifier regardless of field.

jobs.title: Corporate Intelligence Experienced Case Manager - Former Soviet Union, London
jobs.reason: Requires a minimum of 5 years of corporate intelligence experience plus team management/mentoring — a clear senior "Case Manager" role, not entry-level, so it fails the level gate. It also requires high-standard Russian research proficiency as essential, which the candidate does not have. S-RM and commercial intelligence are core-target, but both the experience and language requirements are unmet essentials.

jobs.title: Arabic-Speaking Due Diligence Analyst, (MENA)
jobs.reason: The essential requirement to independently understand and analyse Arabic text and video media is a language fluency the candidate does not hold (their working languages are German and English only), which is a hard disqualifier. S-RM and commercial due diligence sit squarely in the candidate's core interest zone (b), but the Arabic requirement is non-negotiable here.

jobs.title: Corporate Intelligence Senior Analyst - Former Soviet Union, London
jobs.reason: Two disqualifiers apply: a "Senior Analyst" title with an essential requirement to research to a high standard in Russian (a language the candidate does not have), and the role is aimed at experienced analysts. S-RM and corporate intelligence sit squarely in the candidate's core zone (b), but the Russian-language essential and seniority make this a hard no.

jobs.title: Corporate Business Development Manager
jobs.reason: A "Manager" title requiring an essential degree in Materials Science, Chemistry or Physics and a proven track record of closing commercial deals with corporate R&D accounts — none of which the candidate has. It is neither entry-level nor in any of the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Turkish-Speaking Due Diligence Practitioner
jobs.reason: Two hard disqualifiers apply: the posting explicitly states "this is not an entry level position" and requires prior Corporate Intelligence industry experience, and it demands high working proficiency in Turkish as a minimum requirement, which the candidate does not have. Although S-RM and commercial intelligence sit squarely in a core target zone, the level and language requirements are unmet essentials.

jobs.title: Operations Engineer
jobs.reason: This is a deep-technical broadcast-engineering role whose essential criteria — proven broadcast systems engineering, diagnosing complex hardware faults, and electrical safety competence — are entirely outside the candidate's skill set. It bears no relation to the candidate's research, policy or analysis background and sits in none of the interest zones.

jobs.title: Portfolio Manager
jobs.reason: Two hard disqualifiers apply: it is a "Manager" role requiring an experienced programme-management professional with strong donor-funded experience the candidate lacks, and fluency in French is essential (candidate is only B1). The humanitarian development topic is adjacent, but the level and language requirements are unmet essentials.

jobs.title: Internship in the South and Central Asian Defence Strategy and Diplomacy Programme
jobs.reason: Internships are excluded as a matter of policy, regardless of fit. IISS and its security-strategy work sit squarely in the candidate's zone (b), but the role's status disqualifies it.

jobs.title: Programme Coordinator, Huth Initiative for a New Political Economy
jobs.reason: This is an administrative / executive-assistant coordinator role — the essentials (admin, financial, events and diary support, MS Office) are met by the candidate's RA and German Rectors' Conference funding-administration work, so it is a realistic on-level application, though it leans more coordinator than research. It sits in higher-education / research administration and political economy, which is only adjacent to the candidate's core interests, and the emphasis on events, digital comms and executive assistance is a partial gap that limits the pull. (Note: the attachment bundles a separate Research Assistant spec requiring Stata / RCTs / development economics, which is a different, less-fitting role.)
jobs.salary: £36,513–£41,565 p.a. (progressing to £44,468), inclusive of London allowance

jobs.title: Communications Officer, Bloomberg LSE European City Leadership Initiative
jobs.reason: This is a hands-on communications-specialist role whose essential requirements — multi-channel campaigns, CMS/webpage management, press-office support, Mailchimp/Canva/Adobe, editorial calendars — are a substantial gap for a candidate whose dedicated comms/marketing experience is limited. It is London-based and entry-to-junior in level, so eligible, but urban leadership/comms delivery sits outside the candidate's core interest zones and the skills match is weak.
jobs.salary: £36,513–£41,565 pa (progression to £44,468), inclusive of London allowance

jobs.title: Programme Administrator
jobs.reason: Genuinely entry-level administrative work in an academic environment, and the candidate's HRK funding-allocation and RA experience map directly onto the essential academic-administration, IT and stakeholder-communication requirements — a realistic and winnable application in London. However, it is a pure professional-services admin role outside all three interest zones and only an 8-month fixed term, which holds the priority down despite the strong paper fit and LSE-internal advantage.

jobs.title: Senior Communications Manager – Research Integrity, Ethics and Editorial Policy
jobs.reason: The "Senior Communications Manager" title plus essential requirements for strong/proven external communications, PR or corporate-affairs experience and issues/crisis-comms delivery place this well beyond entry-level, and the candidate has limited dedicated communications experience. Academic publishing is adjacent to the candidate's higher-education background, but the seniority and specialist comms focus are a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Analyst, Cyber Threat Intelligence
jobs.reason: Genuinely entry-level with no required certifications, and the essentials it leans on — strong analytical writing, source assessment, OSINT and an IR/Security Studies research background — map directly onto the candidate's profile. S-RM is a core zone (b/c) target and the OSINT/threat-intelligence framing sits well within the candidate's digital-investigations interest; the only real gap is the cyber-technical domain knowledge (attack vectors, MITRE ATT&CK, dark-web fluency), which is a closeable soft obstacle rather than an essential the candidate fails.

jobs.title: Campaign Assistant (Freelance) with Centenary Action
jobs.reason: This is an entry-level, freelance support role centred on campaigning, communications, events and administration — areas where the candidate has only limited dedicated experience, so it is a partial skills fit at best. Women's political representation is adjacent policy interest but sits outside the core zones, and the comms/events/social-media emphasis is where the candidate is weakest. Remote with London-based meetings, so it passes the location filter, but it is a marginal fit overall.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Programme Analytics - SRHR
jobs.reason: A "Senior Manager" title with a £82k salary and essential requirements for substantial quantitative analysis, epidemiological/econometric/cost-effectiveness modelling and mentoring — clearly well beyond entry-level and requiring years of specialist experience the candidate lacks. It is also outside the core interest zones (SRHR programme analytics) and demands technical modelling far past the candidate's analysis-level Python.

jobs.title: Lead Auditor - Information Security
jobs.reason: "Lead Auditor" is a senior, non-entry-level title, and the role requires substantial practical IT and information-security workplace experience (configuration management, disaster recovery, cloud infrastructure) that the candidate plainly lacks. This is a technical assurance/audit role well outside the candidate's research and policy profile.
